newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy future prices narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy future prices narrowly mixed.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices were narrowly mixed as light volume left the market with little direction in NYMEX after-hours trade, brokers said.
"The volume is so light, you can't say which way the market is going," a dealer said.
January crude oil traded at $26.09 a barrel, down seven cents a barrel from the settle as 611 contracts changed hands.
Front-month heating oil shed 0.16 cent a gallon to 74.02 cents amid light volume of 142 contracts in January and 266 contracts.
January gasoline rose a mere 0.03 cent to 71.20 cents a gallon, as 56 lots traded in the nearby month and 66 overall.
